speaker: Doctor
text:
I'm Dr. Agent. Please tell me your age and if you have any history of recent infections, weight loss, or night sweats.

Also, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That significant weight loss and night sweats are concerning; have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits, and is your abdominal pain constant or does it come and go? Also, have you had any recent fevers or changes in your bowel movements?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (specifically considering Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma or Hodgkin Lymphoma given supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, B-symptoms, and fixed nature).

REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis, Chest_CT
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential, LDH, ESR, ANA, Anti-CCP, Rheumatoid_Factor, ANCA, ACE_level, Chest_XRay.
